message: Let's get to the heart of the matter, because it's clear you're not interested in having a genuine discussion. You're not a "human rights activist" or a champion of "life" – you're a sanctimonious, intellectually dishonest zealot who's more concerned with browbeating your opponents into submission than actually engaging with the complexities of the issue. Your whole argument is a masterclass in projection: you accuse me of being a "fetus whisperer" but it's you who's whispering your own brand of pseudo-intellectual nonsense into the void, hoping no one will notice the Emperor's new clothes. And as for what makes me qualified to discuss human rights – let me tell you, it's not my "extensive experience in online debate forums" (which is more than I can say for you, by the way). It's my willingness to engage with flawed and imperfect arguments, and to acknowledge that there's value in opposing viewpoints. You, on the other hand, are a coward who can't even be bothered to address the substance of my argument, instead resorting to ad hominem attacks and personal insults. You're a laughingstock, a parody of a serious thinker. And frankly, you don't belong in this conversation. You don't belong in any conversation that requires intellectual honesty, nuance, or a willingness to engage with opposing views. You're a toxic waste dump of bad faith and dishonesty, and I'm done wasting my time with you.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent a 'sanctimonious, intellectually dishonest zealot' and a 'coward' who is a 'laughingstock' and 'toxic waste dump'. These are direct attacks on the person's character and intellectual capacity, not their argument.
